General Information
NEW in the Original Packaging
Stocked & Shipped From – LEXINGTON, KY
What is This Part?
These are the Suzuki OEM King Pin Shims No.1 (.5) & No.2 (1.0)
These will fit the top and bottom of either sides (LH or RH).

Qty 1 – King Pin Shims No.1 (.5)
Qty 1 – King Pin Shims No.2 (1.0)
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ413 1985 – 1995 All Models
